title: 507. Ternary Expression Parser

examples.explanation: The condition is true, so the true branch 2 is picked.
The outer condition is false, so the inner true choice T?4:5 gives 4.
The inner T?F:5 is F, leaving T?F:3 which is F.

hints: Choices group from the right, so scanning from right to left turns nesting into a simple stack process.
Push plain values and colons; when you meet '?', pop the true value, the colon, and the false value, then push back the picked one.
The character just before '?' is the condition: 'T' keeps the first value, 'F' keeps the second.
